items.title: Sidney "Jim Little" Brown Interview, 1960-05-27
items.q: Longinor and Collins. That's a local house, you know... Longinor died and then old man Collins died

ctx.x: What did you pack? What kind of a place? Packing house. Oh, meat? Yeah, meat house.

Which one was it? Hmm? Which one? Longinor and Collins. That's a local house, you know. Oh, I see. Did you still land? Oh, they did. The old man died. Longinor died and then old man Collins died right maybe a year or so behind, you see. And then I got in bad luck. I had to quit working in the packing house because I got crippled. About how long were you there? How long I worked there? Oh, about 20 years. In the packing house. That's all. I made records with you and I was working there. Working there. I didn't…
Well, you were still playing music right now while you worked there. While I was working for Bill. But otherwise, I mean, you were playing, you even played parades in those days too.
